scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,rust -c cyan,green "vite" "cd .. && cargo run --locked -p imail-http-service -- --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8787"
scripts.build:remote: npm run build:web && cd .. && cargo build --release --locked -p imail-http-service --bin imail-server && cargo build --release --locked -p imail-storage-sqlite --bin imail-maintenance
scripts.test:internal-release: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run rust:test && cd .. && cargo test -p imail --lib --target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc && cd frontend && npm audit --omit=dev && npm run build:web && npm run build:desktop:internal && npm run test:desktop-release
scripts.backup: cd .. && cargo run --release --locked -p imail-storage-sqlite --bin imail-maintenance -- backup
scripts.restore:prepare: cd .. && cargo run --release --locked -p imail-storage-sqlite --bin imail-maintenance -- restore
scripts.upgrade:preflight: cd .. && cargo run --release --locked -p imail-storage-sqlite --bin imail-maintenance -- upgrade-preflight
scripts.rust:mail-acceptance: cd .. && cargo run --quiet --locked -p imail-mail-network --features acceptance-oauth --bin imail-mail-acceptance
scripts.rust:http-contract: cd .. && vitest run --config frontend/vite.config.ts scripts/application-http-routes.test.ts scripts/rust-server-host.test.ts scripts/mcp-rust-sdk-interop.test.ts
scripts.check:frontend: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build && node ../scripts/check-frontend-bundle.mjs
